newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' markets shut for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' markets shut for holiday.

text.p: Indian metals trade was closed on Wednesday for a national holiday and will resume on Thursday, dealers said.

On Tuesday, key Indian metals' prices fell on as price-setter, state-owned Hindustan Zinc announced cuts in its October selling prices, dealers said. Zinc and lead attracted offerings on Hindustan's cut in selling prices. Ready zinc fell by 125 rupees to 6,200 rupees per quintal while lead slid by 50 rupees to 4,950 rupees.
